entry.entry_rule: For each monthly expiry, take the first eligible trading day where DTE is within 42-48; do not optimize entry date/time.
entry.overlap_policy: one position per expiry; no duplicate entries for same expiry
entry.strike_tie_break: nearest absolute delta; if tied choose lower absolute delta; if still tied choose tighter contemporaneous spread

exit.marking: executable-side bid/ask when available; otherwise candidate cannot pass cost certification

candidates.null: After realistic transaction costs and tail-risk accounting, the strategy has non-positive expectancy or its apparent edge is explained by a small number of volatility regimes.
candidates.primary_hypothesis: A mechanically selected NIFTY approximately-45-DTE 16-delta short strangle earns positive net expectancy after realistic execution costs and tail losses because implied variance exceeds subsequently realized variance often enough to compensate negative convexity.

robustness_grid.multiple_testing_control: report full grid and apply family-wise correction; do not replace primary with best cell

features.iv45_source: interpolated ATM/near-ATM implied volatility from real monthly NIFTY option quotes with 35-55 DTE
features.rv20: annualized realized volatility from prior 20 completed NIFTY sessions only
features.term_slope_optional_robustness: iv45 - iv_near; not part of primary gate
features.vrp_zscore: expanding-window z-score using prior observations only, minimum 60 observations

candidates.null: The 45-DTE volatility state adds no incremental value to the frozen BUY-only baseline after costs and regime controls.
primary_endpoints: incremental net expectancy versus identical frozen baseline
change in left-tail 5th percentile trade return

primary_gate.baseline: frozen HTF_RANGE_EXPANSION trade ledger or another exact-SHA BUY-only baseline
primary_gate.direction: do not alter CE/PE direction; context gate only

candidates.primary_hypothesis: The ex-ante NIFTY 45-DTE volatility state contains information about the cost/quality of buying shorter-dated directional options; a preregistered VRP state gate can improve net expectancy or downside-adjusted expectancy of an existing BUY-only signal without using future volatility.

allowed_now: run synthetic unit tests for code correctness only
reasons: core/historical_option_chain_realish.py is explicitly synthetic and infers next weekly expiry; it is unsuitable for 45-DTE certification.
core/historical_option_chain_dataset.py can load real datasets but does not itself prove that the repository contains the required multi-expiry 45-DTE bid/ask/delta history.
existing option-e2e inventory contains durable data-blocked verdicts for missing real option LTP/spread truth in replay paths.

data_contract.coverage_requirement: must include multiple monthly expiries and permit 45DTE entry through 21DTE management
data_contract.timestamp_timezone: Asia/Kolkata or explicitly convertible with provenance

governance.reason: Direct candidate is option selling and conflicts with TradeBot BUY_ONLY policy.

rule_provenance: Video title proves a NIFTY 45-DTE strategy backtest but the accessible page did not expose transcript/rule text.
Canonical 45-DTE Tasty-style public references support 16-delta short strikes and management at/around 21 DTE.
50% profit-taking is treated as canonical-family convention, not as a verbatim video rule.
